does: The update of the client's action state that plays an animation on a character: once, it builds the event of three sets of animation short names (start, loop, end), a float and a flag from the state and sends it to the character's animation blueprint; when the state is left it sends the cancel event with one flag.

evidence.says: The macOS build names the function of the same shape ecl::ASAnimation::Update: it takes the three sets from the state at +0x18, the float at +0x48 and the flag at +0x4c, looks up ecl::animation::GameplaySystem and calls the sender of EoCGE::ASAnimation; the other branch sends EoCGE::ASCancelAnimation with the byte at +0x4d.
A probe while Osi.PlayAnimation runs on the host shows the sender at +0x1BC4C50 called once, from +0x1BC3C2B inside this function.
the macOS build's symbols hold this name; it is tied to this function by the job its read shows
